user_saw: When every automatic web-search provider failed, Gateway logs showed the last fallback provider’s error and hid the first provider’s failure.
summary: The fix preserves and reports the first web-search failure, including a null or undefined rejection, if all eligible providers fail.
reasoning: The July 14 refactor moved the existing `lastError = error` assignment and final throw out of `runWebSearch`, preserving the behavior that overwrote the first failure. The assignment predates the shallow boundary, and the offline path history stopped at a missing object before I could verify when it was introduced.
